A RESOLUTION
Creating the Senate Nuclear Power Study Committee; and for other purposes.

(3) Powers and duties. The committee shall undertake a study of the conditions, needs, issues, and problems mentioned above or related thereto and recommend any action or legislation which the committee deems necessary or appropriate.
